preconditions.description: The input string tiles must have a length between 1 and 7 (inclusive).
Every character in tiles must be an uppercase English letter.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for sequence in generate_all_sequences(tiles) if sequence)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all possible non-empty sequences formed by permuting the letters in tiles, where sequences are formed by selecting any subset of tiles (with repetition allowed for identical letters) and arranging them in all possible orders.
